items.summary: CFO recommendation: freeze new monetization claims, forecasts, and finance-impacting admissions. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 and 629 aggregate clicks are unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage on 2026-10-01 cost $10.8396 across 85 calls and 11 instrumented sites, or approximately $0.1275 per call; this is not comparable to the 2026-09-21 revenue window. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no validated incremental financial outcome is linked to those calls. Infrastructure, registrar, hosting, labor, and other direct costs are absent; therefore fleet contribution margin and budget exposure are not calculable. Monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor limits are also blank. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com affiliate experiment only as a capacity-gated reversible test after one slot is released and overlap clears. Treat clicks, sessions, impressions, conversions, proposals, and shipped output as activity or funnel metrics, not revenue. Minimum finance measurement: a dated provider export mapping each affiliate event to a registered site tracking ID, plus owner-supplied billing exports for hosting, infrastructure, domains, and AI spend covering the same period; then calculate site contribution margin as attributed commission minus directly attributable costs.
